title: Effect heterogeneity reveals complex pleiotropic effects of rare coding variants.
journal: American Journal of Human Genetics, Sep 2026, ahead of print (PMID 42815477). Europe PMC says 'Subscription required', with isOpenAccess=N, inPMC=N, hasSuppl=N, hasData=N. Crossref lists only Elsevier TDM licences. The open preprint is bioRxiv 10.1101/2024.10.01.614806 (v1-v3, CC BY).
data_url: Input summary stats (Genebass UKB 500k exomes): gs://ukbb-exome-public/500k/results/{results.mt, variant_results.mt, pheno_results.ht}. This is a requester-pays GCS bucket. Code: https://github.com/atgu/ALLSPICER (MIT). The authors' intermediate tables sit in the private bucket gs://ukbb-exome-pharma-wlu.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC core records for the paper and preprint PPR918900. NCBI elink to gds/sra/bioproject/gap (none) and Zenodo/Figshare DOI searches (0 hits). I extracted the Genebass downloads text from the app JS bundle. storage.googleapis.com returned HTTP 400 UserProjectMissing for the bucket listing, for results.mt metadata and for the advertised 'tsv' phenotype link: every file needs a billed GCP project. Repo atgu/ALLSPICER holds R/Python code plus one example CSV (36 KB, 418 rows: locus, alleles, pop_AF, gene=ALB, annotation, BETA/Pvalue for fields 30600 albumin and 30680 calcium, no units). The open Genebass browser API (main.genebass.org/api/phenotypes) returned 4,529 phenotypes, but these are the 300k tranche (SAIGE 0.44.5), not the 500k one; all 1,233 continuous traits have inv_normalized=False.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract: ALLSPICE is a likelihood test of proportional vs heterogeneous rare-variant effects across trait pairs. It was applied to 359 continuous UKB traits and found 124 significant heterogeneous events among 11,810 gene-trait association pairs. From the repo scripts: inputs are Genebass 500k gene burden (P<2.5e-6 in more than one trait) and variant-level BETA, filtered by AF cap. I could not retrieve the preprint full text or supplementary tables: bioRxiv returned Cloudflare 1015 and HTTP 429. The AJHG version is paywalled.

a1_downloadable.note: Fails. Bulk Genebass 500k summary stats are only in a requester-pays GCS bucket in Hail MatrixTable format, which needs a billed Google Cloud account (checked: HTTP 400 UserProjectMissing). Individual-level UK Biobank data is controlled access through a UKB application. The paper's result tables are paywalled, and the bioRxiv supplements were not reachable.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Fails. The paper's natural target (heterogeneous vs proportional effect for a gene x trait pair) is ALLSPICE's output and would have to be rebuilt by running the test. The only column-like label is per-variant BETA in Genebass, and that is a different, already-benchmarked project.

a3_inputs_present.note: Pass in the example file only: locus, alleles, gene symbol, annotation (pLoF/missense/synonymous) and AF are present (checked). Protein-level inputs for a backbone would need VEP/HGVSp resolution, and the full set could not be opened.

a4_units_stated.note: Fails. BETA columns carry no units. Continuous traits are not inverse-normalised (inv_normalized=False for all 1,233 in the 300k metadata), so betas are in raw per-field units across 359 traits, and the units live only in the UKB Showcase.

a5_enough_rows.note: Not counted. The paper says 11,810 gene-trait pairs but only 124 heterogeneous positives, which is below 400 for classification. The one opened file has 418 variant rows for one gene.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Unknown. Full Genebass variant_results.mt is Hail MT over ~359+ traits (size not verified). The example CSV is 36 KB.
a6_fits_laptop.note: Fails in practice: reading Hail MatrixTables from a requester-pays bucket needs Hail/Spark plus cloud egress. A subset would fit once exported, but exporting it needs cloud compute.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Cannot check. Neither the 11,810 pairs nor the 124 events could be compared with any downloadable table. Phenotype counts differ by tranche: 4,529 in the 300k browser, and the repo filters to 'final_599_phenotypes' with 359 continuous, which I did not verify.

a8_label_provenance.note: Fails. The heterogeneity label is a likelihood-ratio test computed from the same per-variant BETA and SE summary statistics a model would take as input. That is leakage by construction, and predicting it distils ALLSPICE. BETA itself is a SAIGE regression estimate, not a direct measurement.

existing_models.name: DeepRVAT (deep set network gene impairment score; Nat Genet 2024, PMID 39322779)
existing_models.score_and_split: Abstract only: 'substantial gains in gene discoveries' and better high-risk detection on 34 quantitative and 63 binary UKB WES traits. No split detail was retrieved.

existing_models.name: RareEffect (empirical-Bayes rare-variant effect sizes; Nat Genet 2026, PMID 42608548)
existing_models.score_and_split: Abstract: validated on 100 UKB WES traits, beating recent rare-variant PRS methods. No numbers retrieved.

existing_models.name: VEP benchmark on UKB and All of Us rare-variant burden traits (Tabet et al., Genome Biol 2024, PMID 38951922)
existing_models.score_and_split: 24 predictors ranked by correlation with traits in carriers of rare missense variants. AlphaMissense came first, and the rankings agreed between UKB and AoU.
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Abstract frames circularity and bias in VEP evaluation as the problem; no further unsolved point retrieved.

backbone.name: ESM-2 (missense variant embeddings) would be the natural fit for per-variant effect heterogeneity, but this was not scored because Part A failed.
backbone.licence: ALLSPICER code is MIT. Genebass data terms not reviewed. Paper is under Elsevier TDM licence; preprint is CC BY.

integration.join_key: Gene symbol and GRCh38 locus/alleles (present in the example CSV)

controls.positive_control: Not applicable (rejected). Salvage: known allelic-series genes such as ALB on albumin vs calcium (the repo's own test case) should come out heterogeneous.
controls.negative_control: Not applicable (rejected). Salvage: synonymous-only variant sets should show no heterogeneity.
controls.external_validation: Not applicable (rejected). Salvage: All of Us or Genebass 300k vs 500k tranche.

honest_claim_h3: At best a model would claim to reproduce ALLSPICE's heterogeneity calls among genes with burden P<2.5e-6 in more than one of 359 continuous traits, in mostly European-ancestry UK Biobank participants. That would be learning a statistic computed from its own inputs.
ml_idea: None viable here. Salvage (a separate candidate): predict per-variant cross-trait effect-ratio deviations from ESM-2 missense embeddings, validated on All of Us. It would need open variant-level betas, which this source does not provide without a billed cloud account.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Done: anonymous HTTP to gs://ukbb-exome-public/500k returns UserProjectMissing (requester pays), and the paper and its supplements are paywalled.

verdict_reason: A1 fails. The input Genebass 500k summary stats sit in a requester-pays GCS bucket (needs billed cloud), individual UKB data is controlled access, and the result tables are paywalled with the bioRxiv supplements unreachable. A8 and A2 also fail: the heterogeneity label is ALLSPICE's own test statistic, computed from the per-variant betas that would be the inputs.
